720	And where did he make Israel thirst?	E onde ele fez Israel passar sede?
721	Rashi says: where did it really happen that Yishmael made Israel thirsty?	Diz Rashi: onde isso realmente aconteceu, que Yishmael fez Israel passar sede?
722	The answer: when Nebuchadnezzar exiled them, as it says, "to meet the thirsty, bring water,"	A resposta: quando Nevuchadnetzar os exilou, como está dito: "ao encontro do sedento, tragam água",
723	when they were led among the Arabs, Israel would say to their captors: please, lead us to our cousins	quando eram levados pelos árabes, Israel dizia aos captores: por favor, levem-nos aos nossos primos,
724	Yishmael, and they will have mercy on us.	os filhos de Yishmael, e eles terão compaixão de nós.
725	As it says, "the caravans of Dedanim": do not read Dedanim but dodim, "cousins." And those go out	Como está dito: "as caravanas dos Dedanim"; não leia Dedanim, mas dodim, "primos". E eles saem
726	to meet them and bring them meat, salted fish and inflated skins. Israel thought they were full of water,	ao encontro deles e trazem carne, peixe salgado e odres inflados. Israel pensava que estavam cheios de água,
727	but when they put it to his mouth and open it, the wind enters his body and he dies.	mas quando levam à boca e o abrem, o vento entra no corpo dele e ele morre.
728	Already back then, they were like that.	Já naquela época eles eram assim.
729	Then Elokim opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water, and she went	E Elokim abriu os olhos dela, e ela viu um poço de água, e foi,
730	and filled the skin with water and gave the boy a drink. And Onkelos: the Lord opened her eyes and she saw	encheu o odre de água e deu de beber ao menino. E Onkelos: abriu os olhos dela e ela viu
731	a well of water, and she went and filled the skin and gave him a drink. "And Elokim was	um poço de água, e foi, encheu o odre e deu-lhe de beber. "E Elokim estava
732	with the boy, and he grew up, and he lived in the wilderness, and he became	com o menino, e ele cresceu, e habitou no deserto, e tornou-se
733	an archer." Onkelos: the word of HaShem was his help, and he grew and dwelt in the wilderness, and became a skilled one. It says he became an archer, shooting	arqueiro." Onkelos: a palavra de HaShem o ajudou, e ele cresceu e habitou no deserto, e tornou-se hábil. Diz que se tornou arqueiro, atirando
734	arrows with a bow.	flechas com o arco.
735	Keshet, named for his trade, like chamar, gamal, tzayad, because the letter is stressed with a dagesh.	Keshet, nome pelo ofício, como chamar, gamal, tzayad, porque a letra leva dagesh.
736	He lived in the wilderness and robbed passersby, as it says, "his hand against everyone,	Ele vivia no deserto e assaltava os viajantes, como está dito: "a mão dele contra todos,
737	and everyone's hand against him."	e a mão de todos contra ele".
738	"And he lived in the wilderness of Paran, and his mother took him a wife from the land of Egypt."	"E habitou no deserto de Paran, e sua mãe tomou para ele uma mulher da terra do Egito."
739	"And he lived in the wilderness of Paran, and his mother took him a wife from the land of Egypt."	"E habitou no deserto de Paran, e sua mãe tomou para ele uma mulher da terra do Egito."
740	Rashi says: "from the land of Egypt," from the place where she grew up, as it says, "and she had an Egyptian maidservant."	Diz Rashi: "da terra do Egito", do lugar onde ela cresceu, como está dito: "e ela tinha uma serva egípcia".
741	Why did she take one specifically from there?	Por que ela tomou justamente de lá?
742	As people say: "Throw your stick into the air, and it lands on its root."	Como diz o povo: "Jogue o seu bastão para o ar, e ele cai sobre a sua raiz."
743	It falls on the side of the roots.	Ele cai do lado das raízes.
744	So too with Hagar: Avraham brought her, he marries her, and in the end she goes back to Egypt.	Assim também Hagar: Avraham a trouxe, casou-se com ela, e no fim ela volta para o Egito.
745	"And it was at that time that Avimelech, and Phichol the commander of his army, said to Avraham: Elokim	"E foi naquele tempo que Avimelech, e Phichol, o chefe do seu exército, disseram a Avraham: Elokim
746	is with you in all that you do." Onkelos: "And at that time Avimelech and Phichol, the chief of his army, said to Avraham:	está contigo em tudo o que fazes." Onkelos: "E naquele tempo Avimelech e Phichol, o chefe do seu exército, disseram a Avraham:
747	the word of HaShem is your help in all that you do."	a palavra de HaShem é o teu auxílio em tudo o que fazes."
748	Rashi says: "Elokim is with you": because they saw that he came out of the Sodom upheaval in peace, and that he fought the kings	Diz Rashi: "Elokim está contigo": porque viram que ele saiu em paz da catástrofe de Sodoma, e que combateu os reis
749	and they fell into his hand, and his wife was remembered with a child in her old age. Then they told him: Elokim is going with you.	e eles caíram na mão dele, e a esposa dele foi lembrada com um filho na velhice. Então lhe disseram: Elokim vai contigo.
750	"Now therefore swear to me here by Elokim that you will not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my grandson;	"Agora, pois, jura-me aqui por Elokim que não agirás falsamente comigo, nem com meu filho, nem com meu neto;
751	but according to the kindness that I have done to you, you shall do to me and to the land in which you have lived."	mas conforme a bondade que fiz contigo, farás comigo e com a terra em que habitaste."
752	Onkelos: "Now therefore swear to me here by the word of HaShem that you will not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my grandson;	Onkelos: "Agora, pois, jura-me aqui pela palavra de HaShem que não agirás falsamente comigo, nem com meu filho, nem com meu neto;
753	according to the kindness that I have done with you, you shall do with me, and with the land in which you have lived."	conforme a bondade que fiz contigo, farás comigo e com a terra em que habitaste."
754	Rashi: "and with my nin and my nechad": up to here, a father's compassion for his son.	Rashi: "nem com meu nin, nem com meu nechad": até aqui, a compaixão de um pai pelo filho.
755	Incidentally, we see here that in Hebrew a nechad is a nin.	Aliás, vemos aqui que, em hebraico, nechad é nin.
756	Because he says, "if you deal falsely with me, and my nin, and my nechad," sorry, a son is a	Pois ele diz: "se agires falsamente comigo, com meu nin e com meu nechad", desculpe, um filho é um
757	nin.	nin.
758	"According to this kindness that I have done with you, you shall do with me," since I told you: "Behold, my land is before you."	"Conforme esta bondade que fiz contigo, farás comigo", pois eu te disse: "Eis que a minha terra está diante de ti."
759	Good.	Bom.
